source:
@@U03496@@
Forget where you came from and
honor these sacred oaks.

@@U03498@@
Forget what’s left behind?
How do you do that?
What once you had is always Paradise.
But tell me.
Whar’s that squatting in the dusk
of that cave down there?
Is it three of them I see?

@@U03500@@
Ah! The 福耳库斯三女妖! Yes!
Visit them if you dare—
if it doesn’t turn your blood to ice.

@@U03502@@
Why not?
What I see—what I see astonishes me!
I may be proud, but I must admit
I’ve never seen the like!
They're worse than mandrakes!
How will the most vile of sins
compare when faced with this triple monster?
Not the most horrendous of our Hells
could endure the sight of them at Hell Mouth.
But here they are,
in this land of beauty called classical.
They're stirring—
they seem to have sensed me—
twittering, whistling,
gibbering like vampire bats.

@@U03504@@
Sisters, pass me the eye, to see
who's drawing near our sanctuary.
translation:
@@U03496@@
忘记你从哪里来
尊重这些神圣的橡树。

@@U03498@@
忘记留下了什么？
你是怎么做到的？
曾经拥有的永远是天堂。
但请告诉我。
蹲在黄昏里的那是什么？
那个山洞在那儿？
我看到的是他们三个吗？

@@U03500@@
啊！福耳库斯三女妖！是的！
如果你敢的话就去拜访他们——
如果它不会把你的血液变成冰。

@@U03502@@
为什么不呢？
我所看到的——我所看到的让我惊讶！
我可能很自豪，但我必须承认
我从来没有见过这样的！
它们比曼德拉草还要糟糕！
最卑鄙的罪恶将如何
面对这三重怪物时比较一下？
不是我们地狱中最可怕的
能够忍受在地狱口看到他们。
但他们在这里，
在这片叫做古典的美丽土地上。
他们正在搅动——
他们似乎察觉到了我——
叽叽喳喳、吹口哨、
像吸血蝙蝠一样胡言乱语。

@@U03504@@
姐妹们，把眼睛递给我看看
谁正在接近我们的圣所。
